The '''Sweltering Caverns''' was the name given to a section of the caves within the [[volcanic mesa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. It was inhabited by numerous [[subteroth]]s and [[underwalker]]s.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sweltering Caverns appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
